sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Campuses"."County" AS g, SUM("degrees"."Degrees") AS m1 FROM "degrees" JOIN "Campuses" ON "Campuses"."Id" = "degrees"."Campus" GROUP BY "Campuses"."County"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m1" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL
